limitations: Source review only: no source import, matrix load, control rerun or optimizer call was performed.
The historical branch and matrix proofs are reused by their accepted immutable receipts; their large original traces were not repeated.
An accepted exact prefix is a certificate result, not a claim that the entire production phase completed within every requested native allowance.

No whole case or graph exclusion follows unless the independently checked stated cover obligations are actually all discharged; this driver always leaves case4_excluded and whole_graph_problem_resolved false.
review: The query retains the accepted complete 167127-row matrix with 10769860 nonzeros and all 1103 columns. Every cached array and its complete accepted 167121-row prefix is bound by raw-byte hashes; the six appended rows are reconstructed in original coordinates.

All 191 complete surviving box states and the original branch-cover receipts are rebound. The original three Gram rows give H27+2Q=3 with weights 1,2,3, proving the positive singleton/pair guards imply the corresponding full conditioned box.

Every attempted low branch resets and reads back all 1103 bounds including t=0, then performs exactly one explicit native run. The old basis may be reused but no returned feasible point is accepted. Dual rays are requested only after the existing-ray check reports one.
Lossless NPZ records preserve ray, column values and complete basis statuses before exact interpretation. Native status is a proposal only. There is no feedback, extra ray solve or retry.

For a signed integer multiplier, the exact upper endpoint is the original row upper bound for positive signs and lower bound for negative signs. Python integers form every combined coefficient; its minimum over the entire box is exact. Only a strict positive gap yields an exclusion.

The independent cold imports none of the producer/helper/native optimizer. It reconstructs the 1214-coordinate vector directly from CSR rows, handles the fixed floor coefficient separately, and checks every signed endpoint, box bound, coefficient, gap and branch ancestry.

A checked singleton guard exclusion yields one global selector zero. Only all 50 new low exclusions plus the four accepted prior exclusions eliminate the complete 54-box low family and imply every coordinate in Q is zero. The 137 high boxes remain unqueried.

Complete newline-terminated transcript prefixes can be checked after a forward timeout or error. Partial trailing bytes and forward resource overruns remain reported. The independent cold must itself pass and exit successfully before the outer result accepts any exact prefix.
